tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search Agena's own European AI and developer events that have not ended. Keyless. Returns JSON with total, a `next` page link, and per event: local start and end with time zone and UTC offset, venue and address, price, organiser, description, registration URL, and a one-event calendar (.ics) URL.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Fetch one published Agena event, with its full description. Accepts the event id, its page slug, or its Agena URL.

tools.name: best_next_event
tools.description: Return the matching event that starts first and has not ended, for the same filters as search_events. q only narrows the matches; it does not reorder them.

tools.name: subscribe_calendar
tools.description: Build an https and webcal subscription URL for the same filters. The calendar re-queries Agena on each refresh. For one event, use the event's `calendar` URL instead.

tools.name: list_conferences
tools.description: List the big finance, crypto and AI conferences Agena keeps guides for (Europe, plus Abu Dhabi Finance Week) that have not ended, with dates, city, venue, official site, the Agena guide URL and the sources each fact was checked against. Hand-picked; not part of search_events.

tools.name: plan_my_week
tools.description: Plan a week in one city: up to 8 upcoming events ordered by start time (title, start, venue, URL, one-event calendar), a calendar feed to subscribe to (https and webcal), and, when the city has no events, the nearest cities that do. tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Sign a person up for the Agena agenda email, with the same rules as the newsletter form. Only call this when the person asked for it. Agena first emails them a confirmation link; nothing else is sent until they click it. The answer is the same whether or not the address was already subscribed.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_events, get_event, list_conferences · Public sink: subscribe_newsletter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_events, get_event, list_conferences · Public sink: subscribe_newsletter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
